title: Simple Evaluation Harness for Factual QA
description: This example runs a deterministic evaluation (temperature 0.0, seed 42) of five factual questions against a local model, scoring each with a substring match and reporting overall accuracy.

steps.description: The chat function calls the local Ollama server with temperature 0.0 and seed 42 for reproducible outputs, and demands only the answer with no explanation.
The tasks list holds five (question, gold_answer) pairs: capital of Australia, Apollo 11 landing year, Frankenstein author, 17*24, and Ursinus College founding year.
The loop queries the model for each question, checks if the gold answer appears as a substring in the prediction, and prints PASS or FAIL with the model's actual output.

steps.question: Which question will the model fail on?
steps.answer: The model fails on the Ursinus College founding year, answering 1782 instead of 1869.

steps.description: Loop runs through all five tasks: 4 PASS (Canberra, 1969, Mary Shelley, 408), 1 FAIL (Ursinus 1782 vs 1869).
